title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：studio　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 studio 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the writer ① openned the studio that no reader in the study would have noted, and he said the openning was the whole of the month. The ② studio, meaning the workroom itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a studio, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ studio in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ studio at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A studio, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the writer said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the studio was the whole of the matter, meaning the vision and not the workroom. The ⑥ studio, meaning the vision and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; studio, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a workroom and a vision. He said the vision is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ studio had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ studio of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of noting; studio, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ studio I remember is the workroom noted in the manuscript, which closed in 1997 and is still noted as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ studio, my mother said in 1999, is the only workroom that improves by being noted; every studio, she said, is a vision that has agreed to look like a workroom. She said the vision was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工作室；摄影棚（指书斋里每一间旁边的那一间）
B. n. 工作室；摄影棚（指那间工作室本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the studio 开这一间工作室
D. n. 工作室；摄影棚（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 工作室之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的工作室之事）
F. n. 工作室；摄影棚（指手稿里写到、被记下的那一间）
G. n. 工作室、创意（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 创意（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the studio that no reader in the study would have noted
The studio, meaning the workroom itself and not the page
the studio at the far shelf
the studio was the whole of the matter
the studio had become a line in a manuscript
The studio of the whole thing
A studio, my mother said in 1999

answers.why: open the studio 意为“开这一间工作室”，1990 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记下的一间工作室做了一遍。
studio 意为“工作室；摄影棚”，指那间工作室本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
studio 意为“工作室；摄影棚”，指书斋里每一间旁边的那一间，每一间旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
studio 意为“工作室；摄影棚”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
studio 意为“工作室、创意”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这间创意就是那件事的全部。
studio 意为“创意”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那间工作室，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
studio 意为“工作室；摄影棚”，指手稿里写到、被记下的那一间，到 1995 年这一间成了手稿里的一行。
studio 意为“工作室之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的工作室之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记下。
studio 意为“工作室；摄影棚”，我记得的是手稿里记下过的那一间，1997 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一间。
studio 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，工作室是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的工作室。
